excerpts.author: mariusvanderwijden
excerpts.content:
If headBlock is zero hash: return error
otherwise for safe and finalized, we just don't update them, we just ignore the zero hash

excerpts.author: taratorio
excerpts.content: hey, in light of the non-finality tests and chain splits on fusaka-devnet-3, I was curious whether clients have a max reorg depth limit they support and how many blocks it is? Do we have some rough reasonable number to aim for?

excerpts.author: mariusvanderwijden
excerpts.content: Geth is reorg resistance up to 90k blocks by default. Reorgs in the last 128 blocks are very fast, everything below that is slow. And you need to at least import 90k blocks until you are resistant

excerpts.author: barnabasbusa
excerpts.content:
we have spun up 30 nodes on sepolia, to check if every client combo can pass the fork.

Noticed that some nodes still report incorrect cgc values. 

nimbus nodes report 0x08 instead of 0x04 (non validating nodes) <@&595681804422479873> 
lodestar reports 0x25 instead of 0x04 <@&595681771690000403> 

Are the clients aware of cgc bugs still? https://dora.sepolia.ethpandaops.io/clients/consensus (note most nodes are still syncing, but CLs are in optimistic mode up to head, so the values reported should already be correct).

excerpts.author: potuz
excerpts.content: what' s interesting is that the engine API does not allow to pass zero for these values after the transition block is finalized
